Changelog

Source: CHANGELOG.md

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on Keep a Changelog, and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

[v1.0.0]

  • Both batch and stream kmeans working
  • unit tests for all functions
  • documentation for all functions

[v0.2.0]

  • added initialisation of streaming k-means model
  • added stream update mechanism

[v0.1.0]

  • add tests for batch k-means
  • add github page

[v0.0.2]

  • add batch k-means which is callable from R

[v0.0.1]

  • Initialise package repository
